title: Tool Misuse Taxonomy: Categorizing How Agents Use Tools Outside Their Intended Scope

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A tool misuse taxonomy directly guides tool API design, permission scoping, and safety filter placement. Identifying common misuse patterns enables targeted defenses. Strong causal chain from taxonomy to safer tool design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running 5 models on 20 tasks with 8 tools requires substantial setup. Annotating every tool call for intended-scope compliance requires clear tool specifications. The combination of multi-model, multi-task, multi-tool is complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 5 models x 20 tasks x 8 tools = massive annotation space. Even if not all combinations are used, the experimental matrix is too large. Should be scoped to 2 models x 10 tasks x 4 tools.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
